capabilities: Insert editable logic circuits into notes from the context menu, hotkey, or command palette
Place gates, latches, flip-flops, terminals, and custom blocks and connect them with wires
Configure component options such as input counts, clock edges, and custom block pins
Route and reshape wires with branches and junctions
Zoom, move, and fit diagrams, with edits saved inside the note
disambiguation: Diagram editing only; no simulation of the circuits.
extras: Desktop only (requires Obsidian 1.8.0+); MIT licensed; circuits are stored in the note and work offline with no telemetry, and a command can recover unsaved circuit drafts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw and edit digital logic diagrams inside notes.
summary: Logic circuit editor that embeds digital logic diagrams with gates, flip-flops, and wires directly in Markdown notes.
